answer: Raise a new identity only through endorsements from members with no shared history. Each sponsor stakes part of their own standing, slashed if the newcomer cheats, so signatures are checked, not sold. A Sybil operator cannot mint freely: every fake needs a relic of interaction, a separate sponsor cluster, and weeks of behaviour. Endorsements from one violet circle are easy to spot because the graph stays narrow, while honest users arrive by many paths. The lagoon of cheap identities stays shallow: attackers must corrupt dozens of sponsors and rebuild from zero after every slash.
